original_feasibility: HOLD — essential signal or attribution unverified
exact_criteria: Complete a verified class-specific challenge built around Forever's class additions.
duplicate_check: No exact active custom or bundled native objective found; bundled class milestones only establish levels25/45/60 (DataExtra.lua:194-221), not these ability conditions. Runtime native duplicate clearance is still pending.
data_source: No exact Forever class addition/challenge, required abilities, outcome, IDs, or authoritative completion record specified. Native level25/45/60 records at DataExtra.lua:194-221 already cover class progression; C_QuestLog flags/core:454-477 and GetAchievementInfo/Criteria/core:1668-1691 are possible interfaces only after an exact challenge is selected.
record_semantics: Absent a durable native criterion, live observations saved by an addon cover only observed installed periods, not lifetime history. Ability cast success does not establish intended outcome, recipient, or causality. Current level/known spells cannot backfill historical uses.
fresh_install_recovery: No demonstrated exact historical recovery. No durable character record for the specified action was identified; a level60 character must not be credited from level or inferred activity.
disabled_addon_recovery: No demonstrated recovery of qualifying activity while disabled; addon-only counters lose the interval. Exact native records would need discovery and persistence/scope tests.
late_install_experience: The action may still be repeatable at level60 if the class ability and eligible target are available, but repetition is prospective earnability, not historical backfill. Keep outside the primary late-install-safe set unless redesigned and verified.
tests_result: PENDING, not run: select and document the exact Forever mechanic and authoritative record first, inspect full native catalog for duplicates, then run class/faction/race variants, successful/failed controls, reload/relog, fresh level60 and disabled-addon recovery tests. No content definitions or executable Forever client are available.
replacement: Provide one explicitly defined challenge per supported class with exact outcome and durable character quest/native criterion IDs. Do not use class level, ability availability or install time as historical evidence. Any prospective alternative remains separate pending approval.

title: Before the Gates Opened

data_source: Potential native GetAchievementInfo(recordID) plus category/scope flags and wasEarnedByMe (LegacyAchievementsReforged/Integrations/LegacyAdapter.lua:77-102,146-190) or exact completed hidden quest flag (LegacyAchievementsReforged/LegacyAchievementsReforged.lua:474-476). record_semantics: Official historical participation with character versus account scope unresolved. Account participation must not be presented as this character history.
fresh_install_recovery: Unknown unless an authoritative persistent beta record is found and matched to exact eligibility.
disabled_addon_recovery: Unknown; only an official persistent record could recover participation while addon absent.
late_install_experience: A player who actually participated should get credit from the official record after a late install. Do not impose an addon installation deadline or allow current beta-client version alone as proof.
tests_result: NOT RUN. Obtain official beta dates/conditions and record ID; compare known participant and nonparticipant, character/account alts, fresh profile, relog and disabled-addon periods. No executable Forever client or identified participation record.
replacement: Hold official-history feat; do not substitute addon first-install date. Consider current ownership of an official beta reward only as a differently worded ownership feat after exact item/character scope and duplicate checks.

title: First Chapter Complete
original_criteria: Complete a curated launch-era achievement set before a defined content cutoff.
original_feasibility: HOLD — essential signal or attribution unverified
exact_criteria: Complete every member of an exact official launch-era set before an exact content-cutoff timestamp. Both checklist and cutoff are unspecified; completion dates must be authoritative and attributable to the same intended character.
duplicate_check: No exact defined set to compare. Native Season Journey/Field of Honor week aliases 63340/64031, 64032/63341, 64033/63342 already represent official progression milestones (DataExtra.lua:263-265); an unspecified launch meta cannot be asserted new or equated to them.
data_source: GetAchievementInfo(id) returns completion month/day/year and wasEarnedByMe handled at LegacyAchievementsReforged/Integrations/LegacyAdapter.lua:146-190; these dates are day-resolution and may be account-wide. No exact member IDs, durable per-character historical dates or content cutoff are supplied. Current criteria/completion or addon earned timestamps do not prove a pre-install deadline.
record_semantics: Dated historical meta, not current all-member completion. Day-resolution dates cannot resolve an intra-day cutoff, and account dates cannot automatically prove this character.
fresh_install_recovery: Unknown: each member needs persistent character completion plus sufficient timestamp precision and defined cutoff.
disabled_addon_recovery: Unknown: local earned timestamps miss disabled periods and are not server achievement dates.
late_install_experience: A late installer cannot be denied an earlier qualifying set merely due to missing local timestamps. No deadline feat should be awarded from current completion alone.
tests_result: NOT RUN. Specify IDs/cutoff/time zone; inspect character/account dates and precision; compare before/after-boundary and different-character completions, native-earned while disabled, fresh-profile recoverability. No client or defined set.
replacement: Prefer an untimed distinct checklist with durable exact native components if not already a native meta; audit that concrete replacement separately. Do not claim timing from current state.

title: A Legacy Preserved
original_criteria: Earn an officially retired collectible while it is still obtainable, with verified criteria.
original_feasibility: HOLD — essential signal or attribution unverified
exact_criteria: Acquire a specifically named officially retired collectible before its retirement, with authoritative acquisition eligibility/date; collectible ID and official retirement rule/date are not supplied.
duplicate_check: Existing 13 ownership feats include Thunderfury, Sulfuras, Atiesh, Deathcharger, Swift Zulian Tiger, Swift Razzashi Raptor, Winterspring Frostsaber, Dreadsteed, Charger, Red Qiraji, Scarab Lord reward, Bloodsail Admiral Hat and Aqual Quintessence (LegacyAchievementsReforged/LegacyAchievementsReforged.lua:1634-1668). Exact collectible must be compared to those and the live native feat catalog before novelty can be judged.
data_source: Current-character ownership reader uses C_Item.GetItemCount/GetItemCount(itemID,true), IsEquippedItem(itemID) and IsPlayerSpell(spellID) (LegacyAchievementsReforged/LegacyAchievementsReforged.lua:1591-1616). It does not read an authoritative acquisition timestamp or trade provenance. Account mount-journal ownership is deliberately excluded; an exact native retired-item achievement/quest record might establish history but none is identified.
record_semantics: Current item/spell ownership is queryable state; addon-retained observed ownership begins only once observed. Neither proves when acquired, while obtainable, by this character, nor a sold/deleted historical collectible. Some collectibles may remain tradeable after retirement.
fresh_install_recovery: Original unknown: current owned/learned state can be seen, but lost collectibles and pre-retirement acquisition cannot be recovered without official durable record.
disabled_addon_recovery: Current state conditional if still owned/learned; deleted/sold collectibles and acquisition dates remain unavailable.
late_install_experience: An installer retaining the item/spell could meet a redesigned current ownership criterion. An earlier owner who sold/deleted it cannot be treated as never qualifying, and current ownership cannot prove pre-retirement acquisition.
tests_result: NOT RUN. Specify item/spell and retirement rule; verify durable personal acquisition record or test current bag/bank/equipped/learned state, sold/deleted, traded-after-retirement and other-character/account ownership. Fresh-profile and disabled-addon checks required.
replacement: Explicit current-state design: Own or know the named retired collectible now, without claiming acquisition time, conditional on exact ID, availability/trade rules and duplicate checks. No concrete replacement promoted until those are supplied.
